answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops one operator from trying to forge a thousand fake agents. Each agent must burn a $20 deposit to claim one work slot, recorded on a marble ledger listing every slot and owner. At the nadir of demand, idle slots are reclaimed, so hoarded identities cannot sit unused. Forging 1,000 identities burns $20,000, while an honest agent pays $20 once and earns undiluted rewards, because burned fake slots return nothing.
